propositions: Checkbox-state normalization (case-insensitive bullet types and checked/unchecked states normalized to '[ ]' pre-hash) is not documented in plan-review-gate.md despite being implemented in pass1.py since commit 9ba1e90e3c.
The invalidation rules section (~L469) currently teaches that any description edit invalidates attestations, but checkbox-state flips are now explicitly normalized out and do not invalidate.
The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (~L901) does not clarify that satisfying this precheck (checking boxes at close) is safe for attestation staleness.

Documentation must be aligned across docs/plan-review-gate.md and docs/user-guide.md to consistently reflect that only item-text edits, not checkbox-state changes, invalidate plan-review attestations.
